==Transportation==
*[[Spirit tree patch]] in [[Port Sarim]].
*[[Amulet of glory]] to [[Draynor Village]].
*[[Ring of the elements]] to the [[Air Altar]].
*[[Teleport to House]] with a [[player-owned house]] in [[Rimmington]], or [[Construction cape]] teleport to the Rimmington [[house portal]].
*[[Falador Teleport]] and run south to [[Port Sarim]].
